about: Identifying URL slugs that must never reach committed files (new instructions Step 2, Q-O07). Each pattern's FULL match is the slug; lookarounds give context. Read by pseudonymize.mjs (discovery, capture) and pseudonymize-slugs.py (bulk apply/check). Matching is case-insensitive in both.

rules.why: Katsudoto demo pages live on per-couple subdomains (<names>.katsudoto.id); the label may name real people
Enviory full-preview pages use a couple slug (enviory.com/<slug>?tpl=<theme>)
